text:
Zephyr: Quick sync — proposing a two-week 'Buildathon: SnackLabs' mini-challenge + a 3-part tutorial series and an OSS launch post. Goal: 300 signups, 50 demo requests. Dates: Apr 8–21. Thoughts?
Marta: Love it. Can we make week1 focused on tutorial + starter kit, week2 on refactor challenge? Quick ask: can devrel own starter kit repo + issue template? :raised_hands:
Leo: I can draft the social + blog copy. Ping on voice: "Ship small LLM features with Redwood" — strong CTA to try hosted API and dedicated trials. I'll draft two headline variants.
Jon: For benchmarks we need one low-latency and one throughput narrative. Need representative workloads: chat (2k tokens/session) and batch embeddings (50k req/day). I'll provide rough numbers by EOD.
Claire: Inbound routing — propose form -> HubSpot list 'buildathon-snacklabs', tag 'trial-interest', then webhook to sales-ops. Can we do an automated demo-request follow-up email within 30m?
Marta: +1 Claire. Also recommend an evaluation prompt set in repo to guard quality regressions. Small harness + expected outputs.
Zephyr: Sample UTM for links (please use):
```
?utm_source=buildathon-snacklabs&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=snacklabs_launch
```
Leo: Draft tweet/snippet for copy review:
"Ship a mini LLM feature in 2 days with our SnackLabs starter kit. Build, run, benchmark — free trial. → https://redwood.example/try?utm_source=buildathon-snacklabs"
Jon: Quick infra ask: for the ref app demo we should pin a quantized model to keep costs predictable. Recommending q4_8 for inference. :thumbsup:
Zephyr: Volunteers: Marta (starter kit), Leo (copy + social), Jon (benchmarks + infra), Claire (routing). @Marta @Leo @Jon @Claire please reply 'in' if you're good.
Marta: in
Leo: in
Jon: in
Claire: in
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Buildathon planning sync" on 2024-04-02 16:00 UTC — calendar invite sent to participants.
Zephyr: Great — I'll compile a short launch checklist and share PR for the repo template tomorrow.
